mentions.name: Online Discourse Anti-Patterns site
mentions.description: A site cataloging anti-patterns in online discourse, with individual pattern pages and plans to gather more patterns and build tooling to make them easier to use. Its goal is to raise the quality of comments and posts in forums intended for productive discussion or persuasion.
mentions.problem: Low quality of comments and posts in forums meant for productive discussion or persuasion.
mentions.audience: The goal is to raise the quality of comments/posts in forums where the intent is productive discussion or persuasion.
